problem: The reserved _PID_HLINKS codec treated Value::Blob as if it still contained VtHyperlinkValue.cbData. The generic OLE property codec already consumes/emits that length, so valid native Office vectors were rejected and Litchi-authored values received a second length word. Synthetic read/write tests shared the same incorrect envelope and hid the defect.
changes: Decode Value::Blob directly as VecVtHyperlink beginning with cElements. Encode that vector only, leaving the VT_BLOB type/length envelope to the generic property codec. Plan the four-byte count header correctly and retain the u32 byte-count bound before allocation.

Correct the independent 60-byte vector fixture, outer wire marker, padding/invalid-string offsets and DOC stored-hash mutation offset. Add regressions for the one-length envelope, malformed/truncated/trailing/nested vector data and a four-byte empty vector with exact limits.

Add six native DOC integration tests for reserved hyperlink reads/edits, standard/custom property reads/CRUD, annotation/list-style table bytes and associated-string semantics. Add one shared native Excel/PowerPoint test for wire compatibility and limits.
Index six additional bounded DOC rows (doc-011, doc-017, doc-025, doc-026, doc-033, doc-049), strengthen xls-146/ppt-351 evidence, and document the corrected envelope and qualification limits.
Correct the feature-matrix API path: immutable Package reads use the property_sets snapshot, while the direct user_defined_hyperlinks convenience method belongs to raw::Reader.

specification_evidence.source: User-supplied read-only [MS-OSHARED] 2.3.3.1.18-21 and 2.3.3.2.3; [MS-OLEPS] BLOB boundary implemented by the existing generic property codec.
specification_evidence.finding: VtHyperlinks stores a VT_BLOB type/padding followed by VtHyperlinkValue. Its cbData is the same length that the generic Value::Blob reader consumes before returning VecVtHyperlink bytes. VecVtHyperlink begins with cElements, six variants per hyperlink. No second nested length is specified.
specification_evidence.native_crosscheck: Independent extraction of the native Word blobs yields lengths 128 and 164 with first DWORDs 6 and 12. Their records consume the exact entire payload. Native Excel and PowerPoint vectors similarly begin with counts 6 and 60.
specification_evidence.dependency_policy: Specifications were read for research only; code/tests/tools have no runtime dependency on the untracked research checkout.

verification_scope.word_hyperlinks: Text DOC has one target https://example.com/litchi-fixture with stored hash 7012461/app 0/info 5 and a main field at CP 317..380. Math/navigation DOC has two internal TOC locations in app-index order 8 then 2, stored hash 1769520/info 5, at CP 233..330 and 139..231. Typed candidate counts, marker indices, separator CPs and stored instruction matching are asserted. Shared encoding reproduces the original blobs exactly.
verification_scope.word_hyperlink_edits: An unresolved changed target is precisely refused without discarding a staged summary title. Explicit candidate resolution enables property edits in canonical field order. Original field instructions/results and every non-property stream remain exact. File reopen, forward replay, stale refusal, targeted removal and exact inverse pass.
verification_scope.excel_powerpoint: excel-interaction-print.xls has one link with hash 65629/app 0/info 6. powerpoint-navigation-review.ppt has ten entries repeating five exact web/internal/mail/next/first targets, with hash 7/app 6/info 7. Producer hashes, duplicates and string spelling are retained; no URI or application-field interpretation is performed. Byte-exact re-encoding, generic property-stream reopen and blob/link-count ceilings pass.
verification_scope.doc_properties: Six native DOC/DOT variants retain Mac code page 10000, saved dates/counts/template names, author/application/revision values and review properties. Title/company and Boolean/Unicode custom-property CRUD preserves reserved hyperlink blobs and every non-property stream, including inert macros. Only the user-defined section changes to UTF-16 for Japanese custom text. Unsupported identifier merge leaves prior staged work; no-op/reopen/replay/stale/inverse checks pass.
verification_scope.binary_tables: Exact native annotation tags are 1418134056 (text), and 1194253998/2055799712 (review). Text and math/navigation carry a 16-byte RgDofr ListStyles record for list 0/style 12 with no custom/unused bits. Annotation STTB bytes and all 18 associated-string slots round-trip. The associated template path is empty even when SummaryInformation names a template; the two owners remain distinct.
verification_scope.validation_policy: Typed vector count, variant tags, UTF-16 strings, exact consumption, allocation/size budgets and u32 output size remain checked. A malformed outer BLOB length follows the existing generic parser policy: it records PropertyDefect::MalformedValue and drops the affected property; the regression asserts that diagnostic rather than accepting it as valid hyperlink data. Nested length words are not accepted as a compatibility heuristic.
verification_scope.limits: Previously generated double-length values are nonconforming; this change emits the standard form and does not add a legacy decoder profile. Native saved-selection/print records were absent in the initial plain-DOC scan and are not counted as positive coverage. General frame layout, exhaustive primitives, document variables/web export, field evaluation, external target access, macro execution and fresh Office reopen remain outside this batch.
